crossRefs.note: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you…
because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
yet for love’s sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t…
Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You…
Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts…
As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the…
but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;
For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject…
For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
translations.bsb: Take notice: I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.
translations.kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
translations.asv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that, if ye receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
